verdict.rationale: The Delaware Division of Revenue runs public web portals (revenue.delaware.gov and the authenticated tax.delaware.gov portal), and web services like these can plausibly offer analytics or usage-tracking opt-outs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, cookies, tracking controls or a privacy opt-out. The docs cover only filing, payment, licensing and support, and the probes record only 404s and a portal shell.
